camera.reason: ZEISS 50MP OIS main plus a 50MP 3x OIS periscope telephoto and 50MP selfie camera.

performance.reason: Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 handles most games at high settings.

battery.reason: 6,500mAh with 90W charging lasts well over a day and refills fast.

display.reason: 6.77 inch FHD+ AMOLED at 120Hz with 1,500 nits HBM and 5,000 nits peak.

build.reason: IP68 and IP69 rated; glass back only on the Gold colour.

software.reason: WhatMobile lists up to 4 Android upgrades for the V60.

value.reason: At 137,000 it is the only phone here with a periscope telephoto and Snapdragon 7 Gen 4.

availability.reason: Only one colour of the 12GB 256GB is in stock at PriceOye; no second retailer found.

notes: PriceOye sells the 12GB 256GB at 136,999 in Desert Gold only on 2026-10-10; the 12GB 512GB (145,999) and other colours are out of stock. WhatMobile lists 149,999.
